answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using optical spatial-mode attestation. A verifier projects a saffron probe beam at an agent's coordinates, gathering the reflected optical echo with a photonic lantern. Because distinct spatial wavefronts require discrete apertures, an attacker must deploy dedicated optical transceivers and line-of-sight sites per persona. However, atmospheric turbulence can scramble return phases, causing transient verification failures for honest nodes.
